doc:
A stream in: `Input<T>` is what the caller sends while the call runs.
It is not one of the parameters.

methods.name: put
methods.doc: Keep a file. The caller streams its bytes in.

methods.name: tokens
methods.doc: Count a run's tokens: a stream in of a type of its own.

methods.name: status
methods.doc: Active uploads and bytes read so far, including unfinished uploads.

methods.name: receipt
methods.doc: The receipt of the last completed upload to this name.
